name: Riajuu Plus ver. Komatsuzaki Kaname
original_name: リア充プラスver.小松崎かなめ
source: Real Life Plus Ver. Kaname Komatsuzaki is a game that lets you enjoy life interacting and growing up with Komatsuzaki Kaname, a childhood friend of protagonist, Kouichi. The game is strewn with short segments that explore their relationship with the choices made at each step which alter their lives as they spend their youth with each other.
translation: 《现实充＋小松崎要》是一款游戏，让你与主人公浩一的青梅竹马小松崎要互动，在共同度过的青春中一同成长。游戏由许多短篇组成，每个阶段的选择都会改变两人的人生。
